data.name: Harper
data.gender_notes: Harper is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English hearpe, 'harp' — an occupational name for a harpist. Its root is Old English hearpe. A modern English given name. Harper is a English name meaning “Harp player; harpist”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harper expresses “Harp player; harpist”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old English hearpe, 'harp' — an occupational name for a harpist.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harper total 39, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
